results.label: LV PV loop
results.threshold: systolic pressure dome has <=1 prominent peak, 0 prominent troughs, roughness < 2.4
results.message: LV systolic PV-loop dome is not single-peaked; this can produce a double-humped systolic loop.

results.label: RV PV loop
results.threshold: systolic pressure dome has <=1 prominent peak, 0 prominent troughs, roughness < 2.4
results.message: RV systolic PV-loop dome is not single-peaked; this can produce a double-humped systolic loop.

results.label: LA PV loop
results.threshold: intersection >= 1, area > 20, mid-volume pressure spread > 1.5
results.message: LA PV loop has a readable reservoir/booster loop.

results.label: RA PV loop
results.threshold: intersection >= 1, area > 30, mid-volume pressure spread > 2
results.message: RA PV loop has a readable reservoir/booster loop.

results.label: MVF
results.threshold: normal sinus AV inflow has one E wave, one A wave, and no third forward wave
results.message: MV inflow is not cleanly biphasic; extra or missing waves are present.

results.label: TVF
results.threshold: normal sinus AV inflow has one E wave, one A wave, and no third forward wave
results.message: TV inflow is biphasic with E and A waves.

results.label: LA pressure timing
results.threshold: atrial active peak in theta 0.80-0.10, readable a/v waves and x/y descents, <=3 prominent peaks/troughs
results.message: LA pressure timing is not physiologic enough: atrial kick timing or a/v/x/y morphology is off.

results.label: RA pressure timing
results.threshold: atrial active peak in theta 0.80-0.10, readable a/v waves and x/y descents, <=3 prominent peaks/troughs
results.message: RA pressure timing is not physiologic enough: atrial kick timing or a/v/x/y morphology is off.

summary.currentInterpretation: Current user-0 default failed labels: LV PV loop, RV PV loop, MVF, LA pressure timing, RA pressure timing. LV double-dome attribution: lv-land-valve-load-associated. MVF extra-wave attribution: lv-land-filling-coupling-associated. LAP timing/readability attribution: not-specific-to-landatrial.
recommendedNext: rerun morphology-check-v1 after any model fix; do not continue closed-loop LandAtrial parameter tuning while LV/MVF/LAP badges fail
treat the LV double dome as an LV Land plus valve/load coupling problem; LV-only Land reproduces it and root-current ablation does not remove it
treat the MVF third wave as LV Land/filling coupling until disproven; LV-only Land reproduces it while frozen legacy does not
tighten or split the LAP/RAP pressure timing checker before using it as a LandAtrial tuning signal; frozen legacy also fails the current pressure extrema rule
blockers: This is a closure-local attribution matrix, not a morphology fix or physiology acceptance.
A1/A2 remain frozen diagnostic scaffolds; this runner does not sweep or select them.
Any follow-up fix must preserve output health and rerun morphology-check-v1 over the same profile.
